integrity: Exact symbolic proof with a four-to-one dyadic lifting lemma; a standalone checker independently verifies 65534 finite orbits but finite verification is not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
limitations: The theorem applies to the cubic monic Dickson map modulo powers of two, and specifies odd-leaf incidence for nonfixed cycles. It does not determine individual fixed-point indegrees. Even-component periodicity is prior known Chebyshev mathematics. Inaccessible or unlocated literature might imply an equivalent odd-branch statement.
title: Odd-tail incidence and exact orbit censuses for the cubic Dickson map modulo powers of two
